stream.scope: Final local Docker 0.4.4; deterministic engines, DOM commit observations, not production latency or a measured browser paint event.

checks: Initial wire is measured and bounded; input literal, registry coverage and absence of duplicate HTML are asserted.
Verified resume preserves the SSR input; stream and history work without document replacement.
Invalid signature recovers through descriptors; stream and history work without HTML copy.
No-JS direct SSR search keeps the native search input and results.
ssr.scope: Local Docker 0.4.4; optional baseline URL is measured separately. Signed state, timestamps and signatures vary. Byte/gzip comparison is transport size, not a production latency claim. Marker coverage is not a successful-resume ratio.

checks: Only one centered wordmark and no logo on the classic landing page; heading semantics, light/dark, 320–3840px, full viewport and footer tested.
Persisted wordmark and input morph through real XUtils layout-flip; logo and background fade together, batches do not replay motion, history and animation cleanup work without reload.
Reduced motion and unavailable Web Animations use immediate layout; no-JS landing and native result-header search remain usable.
Six fixture policies saved through Maraca; no document reload.
Save / discard / cancel, live updates during drafts and browser back preserve expected state.
Native XSurfaceManager and XSidePanel, category filters, URL history and 320–3840px layouts.
Four-second favicon responses do not block first paint or stream completion; successful icons retain fixed dimensions.
Anonymous XDialog reports create an inbox proposal; optional evidence is separate and manual decision audited.
Auto cooldown is off; rule preview and versioned rule save work.
Viewer restrictions, no-JS Observatory/logout and no-JS anonymous reporting.

Existing SVG and PNG favicons load. Settings is removed. A genuine lazy XDialog opens from both About links without changing the document, URL or query draft. Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside; Escape and backdrop return focus and scroll.
320/390/720px layouts, light/dark colors, internal scrolling and reduced motion work; the About link stays visible on mobile.
Direct German/English About pages retain favicon and readable sections. No-JS links and a failed lazy import fall back to the standalone page.
Login and authenticated Observatory retain both favicons. Search streaming continues behind the modal, then leaves all results available; dialog toggles preserve the resumed document and result set.
Malformed stream reaches a visible terminal error without retry/fan-out.
Blocked image uses placeholder; preview remains switchable and XLightbox opens the current-page carousel.
Signed pagination retains engine plan and category.
duplicate frames settle without duplicate results or automatic retries.
incomplete frames settle without duplicate results or automatic retries.
